mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month rises in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) > 0.2pp and unemployment rate (UNRATE) > 0.2pp signal economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1500.0), strong housing market activity signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500.0 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 270 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 270 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 3-month rises in housing starts (HOUST) > 0.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) > 0.5% signal synchronized sectoral expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% and INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises > 0.5% and INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), restrictive policy signals reduced liquidity and higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
